name: Noble Goes To Japan
source: In the first (possibly only) part of this visual novel parody, Noble, from the youtube channel Lost Pause, decides he wants to move to Japan and pick up some waifus. This short little game contains lots of inside jokes that you'll really appreciate if you've watched Lost Pause for a while, as well as jabs at the tropes and plot conveniances found in lots of animes and visual novels alike. Hope you enjoy!
translation: 这部视觉小说恶搞作品的第一（也可能是唯一）章中，YouTube频道Lost Pause的Noble决定搬去日本，寻找几个老婆。短小游戏包含大量内部笑话，长期观看Lost Pause的玩家一定会喜欢；同时也会调侃各种动画和视觉小说中的套路与情节便利。希望你玩得开心！
